finding_2_gate_i_name_form.gate_i_test_as_frozen: TDCC 證券簡稱 as an exact substring of the body
finding_2_gate_i_name_form.not_an_argument_for_code_only_identity: any correction must still establish entity identity from a first-party name; this is a comparison-form defect, not evidence that code matching alone is sufficient
finding_2_gate_i_name_form.positive_control_was_censored: the 39/39 control could only run on events that already had a known-good D6.6 body, which is exactly the sub-population where containment holds; it had no power over the 20 events D6.8 was built for
finding_2_gate_i_name_form.why_it_fails: TDCC 1-1 carries the short name; TPEx bulletins carry the full legal name. Containment holds only when the short name is a prefix of the legal name -- not for contractions (華僑商銀 / 華僑商業銀行) and not across punctuation width (大峽谷－KY / 大峽谷-KY)
finding_2_gate_i_name_form.why_not_corrected_here: Q7 amendment: results have been inspected, so exposure is reported and the identity/linkage rule is left to adjudication. Relaxing a gate after seeing which events it rejected is outcome-driven tuning
